result.stdout:
CtorGenerator — .NET tool for generating ladder-style constructors

Usage: ctorgen [options]

Commands:
  init [path]           Create a config template (default: ctorgen.json)

Options:
  --config=PATH         Path to JSON config file
  --name=CLASS          Target class name (required if not in config)
  --out=FILE            Output file path (default: {ClassName}.Ctors.cs)
  --param=DEF           Parameter definition:
                        name:type:hashExpr
                        Example: --param=id:IGuid:new DeterminedHash(id)
                        (Can be specified multiple times)
  --help, -h, /?        Show this help message

Examples:
  ctorgen --name=MyHash --param=id:IGuid:new DeterminedHash(id)
  ctorgen --config=myconfig.json --out=Generated/MyHash.cs
  ctorgen init mytool.json
